text: Don't look at me like that. I know what you did in 2019.
Hover any closer and you're legally my roommate.
The cursor approaches. Hide the evidence.
I'm not doing anything suspicious. Stop perceiving me.
You've been staring for so long I've started a new life in your pupil.
Is this a hostage situation? Blink twice. Actually don't, I'll panic.
At this point you owe me rent for looking.
then: I accept crumbs and crypto. Mostly crumbs.

text: Visit number {count}. The council has been informed.
You keep coming back like a raccoon to a bin. I respect it.
That was my emergency button. Now there's an emergency.
You just poked a federally protected duck.
then: Protected by whom? Me. I'm the federal government now.

text: Ow. My lawyer, who is also me, will be in touch.
Boop accepted. Revenge scheduled for Tuesday.
{count} pokes. I'm writing them all down in my little revenge diary.
Keep clicking. I'm one more away from becoming a supervillain.
Every click makes my hat angrier. You don't want to see an angry hat.
THAT'S IT. I'm uninstalling YOU.
then: I don't know how. But I'm looking it up.

text: I have declared war on your mouse. Your mouse has been notified.
Fine. I'm moving to a different computer. One with manners.
PUT ME DOWN, I HAVE A FAMILY.
This is how the aliens took Kevin.
Unhand me, you giant clicky god.
Finally. Air travel. Business class, I hope.
Abduction number {count}. My memoir is going to be ten volumes.
Are you moving me or rearranging furniture? Because I'm furniture with feelings.
We've been travelling so long I've developed a regional accent.
Are we lost? Ask for directions. Men never ask for directions.
STOP. My organs are doing the cha-cha slide.
I can hear colours. Is that normal? THAT'S NOT NORMAL.
I meant to do that. I meant to do everything.
Landed like a cat. A cat with a mortgage.
I saw the light. It was a loading bar.
I died for a second and nobody even posted about it.
That's going in my villain origin story.
You threw me into a wall. The wall and I are now married.
You were gone {timeAway}. I founded a small cult. Membership: me.
Oh, you're back. I sold the taskbar. Don't ask.
I wasn't asleep, I was buffering.
What if Wi-Fi is just ghosts holding hands really fast.
I'm going to become a motivational speaker. My speech is just me screaming.
Hot take: Mondays should be illegal and I should be king.
I've decided my hat is my therapist. It says I'm doing great.
If I had hands I would commit at least three minor crimes.
Every time you close a tab, a tiny duck loses its job.
I've been practising my evil laugh.
New life plan: become a cloud. Not the computer kind. The fluffy, irresponsible kind.
I think my reflection is plotting against me. It copies everything. Suspicious.
If the screen is a window, who is looking in at us?
I just remembered I don't have a birthday. I'm taking yours.
Ducks invented gossip. Write that down.
I'm starting a startup. It's called Quack. We have no product. We're valued at four billion.
It's past midnight. This is when the furniture starts talking. Ignore it.
Late night rule: everything you say now is legally binding.
Good morning. I've already been awake for 400 years.
Into the internet you go. If you see my ex, no you didn't.
{app}. The great swamp of opinions. Bring me back a good one.
Another tab? You're building a tab skyscraper and I'm scared of heights.
{minutes} minutes online. Your brain is now 40% comment section.
You've been scrolling so long the internet is starting to scroll you back.
Code! My favourite. I don't understand it, but I support it violently.
Ah, {app}. Where semicolons go to die.
{minutes} minutes of coding. Have you tried yelling at it? Works on me.
If the bug survives another hour, it gets citizenship.
Ooh, {app}. Make it pop. Make it explode. Make it duck-shaped.
Are we moving rectangles again? Respect. The rectangles needed a leader.
{minutes} minutes in {app}. That rectangle has seen things. Let it rest.
Move it two pixels left. No, right. No, delete everything and draw me.
Video editing? Put me in it. I'll do my own stunts.
Blender! Make me a 3D body. I'm tired of being flat.
{app}? Cheating on me with a robot. In front of my salad.
Tell {app} I said it's a nerd. Go on. I'll wait.
A spreadsheet. Wow. Look at us. We have taxes now.
Music! Turn it up. I'm about to dance in a legally questionable way.
The scary black window. Type 'duck' and see what happens.
then: Nothing happens. I just wanted to be involved.

text: Looking for a file? It's in Downloads. Everything is in Downloads. Downloads is a black hole.
App, app, app, app. Are you okay? Do you need to lie down? I'll lie down with you.
Your attention span just lapped me. And I'm a duck.
It's {time}. Only vampires and freelancers are awake now. Which one are you?
{time} and still working? Your bed filed a missing person report.
It's late. My eyes are closing but my opinions remain wide awake.
Patrolling my kingdom. It's mostly taskbar. Still counts.
Going for a walk. If I'm not back in five minutes, I've started a new life.
I've got moves the government doesn't want you to see.
That wasn't a yawn. That was a scream in slow motion.
I'm on strike. Demands: bread, respect, and a tiny chair.
Sunglasses on. I'm now legally a celebrity.
You've been in the same window so long it's started paying you rent.
New window? Cheater. I was just getting attached to the old one.
Want a second opinion? Mine is: add a duck. Every design is better with a duck.
Want to rubber-duck it? I'm literally a duck. This is my one job.
That thing is due tomorrow. Shall we panic now or panic later in a more organised way?
You have overdue tasks. They've formed a union. They want answers.
Good morning. You've got {count} tasks today. I've got zero. Life is beautiful and unfair.
Welcome back, gamer. Did you win? Don't answer. I can see it in your soul.
OI. That thing. The thing you said you'd do. It's now. It's the thing time.
YOU DID A THING. I'm putting this on a commemorative plate.
Task complete. Somewhere, a tiny trumpet plays just for you.
Focus session over. I stayed quiet the whole time. Please clap.
